cohort: 303 women with live singleton pregnancies without prior cesarean delivery undergoing a labor induction lasting >24 h between September 2006 and March 2009 at Duke University Hospital.
finding: The overall cesarean delivery rate among women with labor induction lasting over 24 hours remained constant at 57% and did not change with time.
mod_finding: Increasing BMI and birthweight were independent predictors of cesarean delivery among nulliparous women with prolonged labor induction.
